reason: I've never heard of REPAIHUB and this is my retirement savings, so I won't hand it to a brand-new company on a web page. The free CA call and fee-only-on-arrival help, but I'd want to check everything myself and see others who've used it first.
objection: Why would I trust a new startup with ₹20 lakh? If the TDS or Form 146 is wrong, I'm the one who answers to the Indian tax office and the CRA, not them.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the CA's name and membership number so I can verify them, the FINTRAC registration checked on the public register, and a few real reviews or a video from an NRI finance channel I follow from people who moved a similar amount.
